The document describes a Radar Continuous Level Transmitter for molten salt services.
It includes specifications such as model number, material, power supply, and calibration range.
The transmitter operates in hazardous areas classified as Class 1, Div 2.
Electrical connections are made using 1/2" NPT and the enclosure is protected by NEMA 4/NEMA 4X.
The instrument has a mounting kit for 2" - 316 SS material.
